about:
# EllesmereUI Broker

An EllesmereUI settings launcher for your LibDataBroker display.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Open EllesmereUI options from a broker bar.
- Lightweight dedicated launcher.
- Preserves the upstream UI suite’s own configuration.

## Requirements

EllesmereUI

A LibDataBroker display such as Bazooka is needed to show broker controls.

## Controls

Left-click the EllesmereUI broker launcher.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `EllesmereUI_LDB` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.2.0`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/EllesmereUIBroker/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
